https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/d.title: Configuring logging for a protection pack (web ACL)
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/d.goal: Enable and configure logging for an AWS WAF protection pack (web ACL) using the AWS WAF console

prerequisites.what: A configured logging destination (e.g., CloudWatch Logs log group, S3 bucket, or Firehose delivery stream) whose name begins with aws-waf-logs-

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/d.title: AWS WAF logging destinations
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/d.goal: Choose a logging destination (CloudWatch Logs, Amazon S3, or Firehose) for AWS WAF logs. The page is an index that links to the per-destination setup pages.

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/d.title: Sending protection pack (web ACL) traffic logs to an Amazon Simple Storage Service bucket
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/d.goal: Send protection pack (web ACL) traffic logs from AWS WAF to an Amazon S3 bucket

prerequisites.what: Amazon S3 bucket for logging, in the same account that manages the protection pack (web ACL), with a name starting with aws-waf-logs-

Permissions for the user managing AWS WAF to configure logging and log delivery (e.g. AWSWAFConsoleFullAccess or AWSWAFFullAccess managed policy, or an equivalent identity-based policy with wafv2, logs and s3 actions)

Bucket policy allowing the log delivery service (delivery.logs.amazonaws.com) to write logs to the bucket; added automatically if the creator owns the bucket and has GetBucketPolicy/PutBucketPolicy, otherwise the bucket owner must add it manually
KMS key policy allowing AWS WAF logging to use the customer managed KMS key, required only if the bucket uses SSE-KMS encryption with a customer managed key

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/U.title: Access management for AWS resources
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/U.goal: Understand how IAM controls access to AWS resources through policies and how requests are authenticated and authorized (conceptual overview, not a task procedure)

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/lat.title: Adding a bucket policy by using the Amazon S3 console
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/lat.goal: Add or edit a bucket policy on an Amazon S3 bucket using the S3 console and the AWS Policy Generator

prerequisites.what: An existing S3 bucket (general purpose or directory bucket) to attach the bucket policy to
AWS Management Console access with permissions to sign in and view or edit the bucket's policy
An active IAM Access Analyzer account analyzer (only needed for the optional Preview external access step)

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/U.title: Getting started with AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/U.goal: Understand the requirements (permissions, service-linked role, Regional enablement) needed to use and manage IAM Access Analyzer

prerequisites.what: Permissions for the account/identity to configure and use IAM Access Analyzer (e.g., IAMAccessAnalyzerFullAccess or ReadOnlyAccess managed policy attached to the IAM identity)
Permissions to view the findings dashboard (GetAnalyzer, ListAnalyzers, GetFindingsStatistics actions)
Service-linked role AWSServiceRoleForAccessAnalyzer (created automatically when an analyzer is created)
Delegated administrator for IAM Access Analyzer when used within an AWS Organizations organization
